base_member_text: L952-L958: freezing point TF is computed from SAL(L,KC) but the enclosing restart loop assigns cell LL (from Map2Local @L870); L is a different variable in this scope - whether SAL(L,KC) vs SAL(LL,KC) is intended cannot be resolved in this file.
audit_member_text: The freezing-point calculation uses SAL(L,KC) at L959-L963 while the enclosing global-to-local loop is indexed by LG/LL and L is not assigned on that path. This is a use-before/stale-index error; it should use SAL(LL,KC). It can read an unrelated cell or exceed the local range.
dispositions.rationale: freezing-point TF uses SAL(L,KC) while enclosing loop indexes LG/LL — stale L
dispositions.decided_by: llm:claude-opus-4-8 (pilot; self-adjudicated, UNBLINDED — mechanics validation only)

base_member_text: L1238-L1240: the NQCTYP 3/4 lower-chord state is read from unit 1 (read(1,...)) while the restart file is open on unit UINP (@L520) and no unit-1 open precedes these reads in Restart_In; the mirror-image write in Restart_Out uses unit 99 (@L251-L253).
audit_member_text: Hydraulic-structure rating-curve records have a writer/reader contract failure. Restart_Out writes SAVESUB/SAVESVB first, LOWCHORD second, and NCTL/NLOWCHORD third at L257-L259 to unit 99; Restart_In reads NLOWCHORD first, then SAVES, then LOWCHORD at L1237-L1239, and reads from unit 1 instead of UINP. In serial this consumes the wrong/unopened stream in the wrong order; MPI explicitly stops before it.
dispositions.rationale: lower-chord/rating-curve restart read on unit 1 not UINP; B adds write/read order mismatch
dispositions.decided_by: llm:claude-opus-4-8 (pilot; self-adjudicated, UNBLINDED — mechanics validation only)

base_member_text: L702: at LG == 2 the file values are read directly into model variables NSEDS, NSEDS2 (read(UINP,*,err = 1019) NSEDS, NSEDS2), overwriting configured class counts; the non-transport branch instead reads into III, III (@L718).
audit_member_text: The main restart format overwrites NSEDS and NSEDS2 from the file at the first global cell (L702-L705) after NMAX and array/read loop expectations were computed from the current configuration at L514-L520. A class-count mismatch can therefore partly consume the stream using old bounds and then switch bounds for subsequent cells, misaligning all following records; no compatibility check is made.
dispositions.rationale: restart overwrites configured NSEDS/NSEDS2 from file at first global cell
dispositions.decided_by: llm:claude-opus-4-8 (pilot; self-adjudicated, UNBLINDED — mechanics validation only)

base_member_text: L662-L671, L833, L983-L985: shellfish larvae (ISTRAN(4)) restart reads into local SFL/SFL2 with comment '! *** delme - not MPI' and the broadcast/local-populate sections are placeholders ('! PLACE HOLDER' @L833) - SFL restart is not MPI-propagated in this file.
audit_member_text: Restart_In reads shellfish rows into local SFL/SFL2 indexed by global LG on the master at L667-L670, then the conditional broadcast branch for ISTRAN(4) is only a placeholder at L831-L833 and the local-population branch is also empty at L984-L986. Shellfish restart values therefore do not reach nonmaster ranks and may be incorrectly indexed even on master.
dispositions.rationale: shellfish (ISTRAN(4)) restart reads local SFL/SFL2 by LG, broadcast/populate are placeholders
dispositions.decided_by: llm:claude-opus-4-8 (pilot; self-adjudicated, UNBLINDED — mechanics validation only)

base_member_text: L488, L547-L548, L620+: ISCOCHK is read only when Restart_In_Ver >= 720; for the <= 710 path ISCOCHK is used at L620/L630/L648/L662/L673/L692/L730 without any assignment in this file.
dispositions.rationale: ISCOCHK read only Ver>=720 but used on <=710 path unassigned

dispositions.rationale: Gather stores derived total ice; Restart_In reads as plain thickness — round-trip asymmetry

audit_member_text: Shellfish restart state is not gathered for output: Gather_Restart_Arrays leaves the ISTRAN(4) branch as TODO at L2290-L2293, while Restart_Out writes SFL_Global and SFL2 at L128-L131. Thus master output can use stale/unpopulated global shellfish arrays; the second record also writes SFLSBOT again instead of a distinct prior-state bottom value, and Restart_In symmetrically overwrites SFLSBOT twice at L669-L670.
dispositions.rationale: shellfish Gather TODO + SFLSBOT written twice (output side)
dispositions.decided_by: llm:claude-opus-4-8 (pilot; self-adjudicated, UNBLINDED — mechanics validation only)

audit_member_text: Drying state read on master (ISCDRY_Global, NATDRY_Global, IDRY_Global at L590-L592) is consumed on every rank during local mapping at L878-L886, but the primary broadcast list at L760-L815 broadcasts SUB/SVB and omits all three drying arrays. Nonmaster wet/dry masks can consequently be derived from uninitialized or stale globals.
dispositions.rationale: drying state ISCDRY/NATDRY/IDRY consumed all ranks but omitted from broadcast
dispositions.decided_by: llm:claude-opus-4-8 (pilot; self-adjudicated, UNBLINDED — mechanics validation only)

audit_member_text: The legacy ISDRY==99 path reads ISCDRY_Global/NATDRY_Global/IDRY_Global/SUB_Global/SVB_Global only on master at L1604-L1613, then immediately maps them on all ranks at L1616-L1627 without any broadcast, repeating the same MPI inconsistency.
dispositions.rationale: legacy ISDRY==99 path maps drying on all ranks with no broadcast
dispositions.decided_by: llm:claude-opus-4-8 (pilot; self-adjudicated, UNBLINDED — mechanics validation only)

audit_member_text: For restart version >=1200 with ISGOTM>0, TKE3D_Global/EPS3D_Global/GL3D_Global are read only on master at L606-L610 and used on every rank at L913-L921. No broadcasts for these three arrays appear in the communication section L760-L861, so nonmaster turbulence restart state is undefined.
dispositions.rationale: Ver>=1200 ISGOTM>0 TKE3D/EPS3D/GL3D read master, used all ranks, no broadcast
dispositions.decided_by: llm:claude-opus-4-8 (pilot; self-adjudicated, UNBLINDED — mechanics validation only)

audit_member_text: Temperature validation is internally contradictory: the ice logic permits a negative freezing point TF and raises values only up to TF at L955-L975, but the later general loop forces TEM and TEM1 to at least zero at L1469-L1470. All physically permitted subzero restart temperatures are erased.
dispositions.rationale: ice permits negative TF but later loop forces TEM/TEM1>=0
dispositions.decided_by: llm:claude-opus-4-8 (pilot; self-adjudicated, UNBLINDED — mechanics validation only)

audit_member_text: Bathymetry-change correction is unreachable under the condition that creates it. ISBELVC is set only in the ISRESTIOPT!=0 branch when BELTMP differs at L566-L583, but the velocity correction later requires ISRESTIOPT==0 and ISBELVC==1 at L1506-L1508. Consequently changed-bottom restart fluxes are never rescaled.
dispositions.rationale: ISBELVC set only when ISRESTIOPT!=0 but correction requires ==0 — unreachable
dispositions.decided_by: llm:claude-opus-4-8 (pilot; self-adjudicated, UNBLINDED — mechanics validation only)

audit_member_text: The bathymetry-change diagnostic writes IL_GL twice (`I,J` format) at L576 instead of IL_GL/JL_GL, hiding the actual row coordinate. The shallow-depth warning at L597 uses local IL/JL indexed by global LG rather than IL_GL/JL_GL, which can be out of range or report the wrong cell under MPI.
dispositions.rationale: bathymetry diag writes IL_GL twice; shallow warning uses local IL/JL by global LG
dispositions.decided_by: llm:claude-opus-4-8 (pilot; self-adjudicated, UNBLINDED — mechanics validation only)

audit_member_text: Debug restart exports compute bed thickness with KBT(LG) while iterating LG=2..LA_Global at L365-L368 and again at L393-L396. KBT is local whereas HBED_Global and the loop index are global; this can overrun local storage or truncate/sum the wrong global bed layers.
dispositions.rationale: debug restart uses local KBT(LG) while iterating global LG
dispositions.decided_by: llm:claude-opus-4-8 (pilot; self-adjudicated, UNBLINDED — mechanics validation only)

audit_member_text: WQ_WCRST_IN's formatted path reads file identifiers L,M but stores values at loop positions WQV_Global(LG,K,...) at L1917-L1922, unlike the binary path which reads LG,K and uses them at L1934-L1938. Reordered, sparse, or mismatched formatted rows silently attach water-quality state to the wrong cell/layer instead of validating the identifiers.
dispositions.rationale: WQ_WCRST_IN formatted path stores by loop pos not file-read L,M identifiers
dispositions.decided_by: llm:claude-opus-4-8 (pilot; self-adjudicated, UNBLINDED — mechanics validation only)

audit_member_text: Setup_Continuation_Files constructs unquoted shell commands from OUTDIR and RESTARTF-derived paths and ignores RESLOG after each SYSTEM/SYSTEMQQ call at L2050-L2101. Paths containing spaces/metacharacters can fail or alter command interpretation, and a failed copy is followed by Restart_In(1) at L2107 with no existence/success check.
dispositions.rationale: Setup_Continuation_Files builds unquoted shell commands, ignores RESLOG
dispositions.decided_by: llm:claude-opus-4-8 (pilot; self-adjudicated, UNBLINDED — mechanics validation only)
